full_page.content:
1932, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 28 Cont.
March Vesta Ray - 24 - of Flint - Operation for mastoids Saturday last - now fears spinal maningitis.
Willard Ingalls - Strepticotic - to hospital
Mrs. Cunningham 47 - bad lump over left heart. .. .
Mrs. Morcott - cured three years ago - now listening to fakers gone entirely away from Christianity
Blind lady from Toledo
Ida Denk - accident forsworn
Page 29
1932, April
Apr. 1 John, Peter Budzinski 69 - 25 years an invalid never walked - Bed- riden first now full of ulcers.
Pauline Smih - 13 - St. Vitus dance
Girl 17 breaking Mother's heart, drinking - going to blind pigs etc. Mrs. Hope paid $13,000 on property - owes about 5,000 and cannot pay dues.
Examination To-morrow 8 a.m. for position, Wm. Carpenter Jack Petrie - 16 - deaf or quite hard of hearing - never baptized Dorothy F. - 15 - bad flu - inflamatory Rhumatism
Page 30 Apr. 8 Thomas Morrison - now in St. Louis - R.E.M. 's brother - plurisy & pneumonia.
Cornelius Duggan - mental - in receiving Hospital - over scrupu- lous.
Mrs. Manion 76 - 2256 Webb - for a long time pernicious enemia - now perfect - Thank God.
Mrs. Edith Sweeney 53 - non c. - inward cancer - son & daughter converts - devout Catholics.
Tho's Manion - 32 - of Ottawa - strepticoctic infection - 3 little girls.
